task: Implement BucketArtifacts in package bucket. It receives projects and work artifacts and must assign each artifact to exactly one project or "unrelated". Match case-insensitively using explicit project signals: project name, project code, ticket prefix followed by '-', or any configured alias as a whole word/phrase. If signals from multiple projects occur, choose the project with the greatest number of distinct matched signals; ties must be unrelated. Do not use loose substring matches inside larger alphanumeric words. Return assignments in input artifact order.
